mq_awakening.title: Echoes in the Whisperwood
mq_awakening.description: You woke beneath the old trees with no memory, only a cracked pendant that hums toward a distant light.

steps.text: Find whoever is calling out on the forest road
Follow the road north to Vael Harrow
Speak with Elder Maren in the plaza

mq_choir.title: The First Verse
mq_choir.description: Elder Maren will let you look for answers in the Choir Steps, but only once the east road is safe.

steps.text: Clear Bramble Wisps from the east road
Climb to the Choir Steps on the eastern ridge
Defeat the guardian of the Hollow Sanctum
Tell Lyra what happened in the Sanctum

sq_toma.title: Petals for a Price
sq_toma.description: Toma swears there's a buyer for Sunpetals. There is always a buyer, according to Toma.

sq_ostin.title: The Voice in the Falls
sq_ostin.description: Brother Ostin says pilgrims hear voices at Silverfall. He wants to know if you hear them too.

steps.text: Return to Brother Ostin at the chapel
